note: His feet are bare in the snow, which is wrong for Norway in winter. Give him warm boots and trousers. Keep him seen from behind.

after: Seen from directly behind, so that only the back of his head and shoulders show: an Ethiopian man with dark brown skin and short black hair, in a heavy dark winter coat and trousers, seated on a low wooden sled and pushing himself with two short poles across deep snow in a Norwegian pine forest under a pale winter sun, with his bare feet remaining completely unshown.
